target_moa.text: Naloxegol is a PEGylated derivative of naloxone that acts as an antagonist of opioid binding at the mu-opioid receptor, functioning as a peripherally-acting mu-opioid receptor antagonist (PAMORA) in the gastrointestinal tract to decrease the constipating effects of opioids.

citations.quote: Naloxegol is an antagonist of opioid binding at the mu-opioid receptor. When administered at the recommended dose levels, naloxegol functions as a peripherally-acting mu-opioid receptor antagonist in tissues such as the gastrointestinal tract, thereby decreasing the constipating effects of opioids.
MOVANTIK (naloxegol), an opioid antagonist, contains naloxegol oxalate as the active ingredient. (Naloxegol is a PEGylated derivative of naloxone.)

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (>=3%): abdominal pain, diarrhea, nausea, flatulence, vomiting, and headache. In pooled Studies 1 and 2, abdominal pain occurred in 21% (25 mg) and 12% (12.5 mg) vs 7% placebo; diarrhea 9% vs 5%. Possible opioid withdrawal occurred in 3% (14/446) of the 25 mg group vs <1% placebo.
